question: Identify all cards that meet the following criteria: (1) illustrated by 'Wayne Reynolds', (2) legal in either 'standard' or 'modern' formats with status 'Legal', (3) have a black border, (4) cost more than 2 converted mana, and (5) belong to sets released after January 1, 2018. For each card, return its name, set code, release date, converted mana cost, and whether it has sensitive content.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    c."XCL_049" AS name,
    c."XCL_063" AS set_code,
    s."XCL_112" AS release_date,
    c."XCL_011" AS converted_mana_cost,
    c."XCL_064" AS sensitive_content
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'Wayne Reynolds'
  AND c."XCL_005" = 'black'
  AND c."XCL_011" > 2
  AND s."XCL_112" > '2018-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM legalities AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_086" = c."XCL_072"
      AND l."XCL_084" IN ('standard', 'modern')
      AND l."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  )
